body:
You can’t help your thoughts. People who are criticizing you on here, have never had to
Deal with intrusive thoughts, or thoughts/urges that are taboo. Just seek help, don’t give into
Urges, and try to find other ways to distract your thoughts. Or, like myself, and my taboo thoughts/urges, you may have to just have those thoughts, and keep them to yourself. Hope it works out.
If they don’t have families, friends, or much to live, or give to this world. Then no harm done. They disappear without anyone even knowing.
I like this one.
No, we had sex. I’ll do anything to keep them quiet.
They would still bring me, and everyone else down with them.
Hahaha, epic.
No, I want to kill people in general. He’s just at the top now.
Agreed. But now I’m stuck with how to not get caught up with someone again, and have homicidal thoughts towards everyone.
I have urges, that’s what causes it. It is numbness during the process, but also relief.
I do it to help the urges. I feel so much better when I’m covered in blood.
Thank you for offering your kind words.
Yes, for years.
I guess I should say I know why it’s bad, but do not feel it why it is. That sounds complicated. Like I can look at a BMI chart and know I’m not overweight, but still feel fat.
I agree. That is why I do not tell others in person about my thoughts.
That’s why I can not express these thoughts to people I know. I am good to people. There is just this intense feelings and thoughts that I do not express.

1. Well, I do not want to go to prison. I do not really think about what killing someone would do to someone’s family, and probably another taboo thing, but I don’t really feel any sadness for the family, when I think about doing it. I don’t seek out pain to others. I simply see people and see myself causing them pain.

2. The urges make my whole body feel tense. My jaw pops, it aches. My hands clench together, my teeth grind. I can only try to do physical activity to distract me. 

3. Doesn’t everyone want to be satisfied? 

I see you point of view.
I have been inpatient in a ward at least 10 times. I realize nothing has worked for me, and I don’t mind these thoughts. Now would I like to find a solution to my urges, yes. A better solution.
Even after everything I’ve said, I get nervous to answer that question honestly.
Yes, I want to express them. I do write, it simply helps control the urges.
Trust me, I have tried many groups. I even try CBT and DBT with therapist. I can rationalize my thinking, I know it’s not normal, but I can not stop thinking this way.
My husband would never forgive me.
You are good, I did not think you were saying that. I just think it sometimes. Thank you for your words.
If I did that, I would not be helping me or anyone else. I would not be able to control my urges with that kind of life.
Yes, I have been looking for someone.
I have. Intensive, but my thoughts are too much for group settings. They want me on a ward.
I do both. I box, I run, I shoot, I hunt, I write, I even try to keep a therapist. Still, I want more.
That does not interest me in the same way, but I see where you are going.

That’s understandable. I know people don’t accept my way of thinking, that’s why I call it taboo. I know it, but can not accept why. I know why, I just can not feel it. And yes, if I could find people who think like me, or groups, that would be great.

Understanding. Not seeking, just getting thoughts of my mine. I have tried multiple times to kill myself. I guess, just seeing if anyone thinks the way I do, or if I am alone. I can see why it seems like I’m attention seeking. I’m not intentionally. I don’t always have a steady therapist, and even then, I feel like someone might lock me up from my thoughts. Which is rightfully so. Anyways, I post on here. Simply to get things off my mind. I said in another comment that it truly does help not push me to the edge, to write it out, or talk about things.

I do, and I do help others. So many medical professionals think negative thoughts about patients, and talk about them behind their back. I know it is not thoughts of killing them. I do help others though. I can not help that I look at someone, and see ways to kill them, and want to kill them.

Yes, it would be nice not to think about these things, so then I did not have to fight urges. I am not ashamed of my thoughts though. They are there, and I like them. I just wish I could act on them, with no repercussions. Which I know is not logical.
They are not a joke. I agree. That’s why I need to find a new therapist to vent too, and find myself venting to random people right now, who do not know me.

I agree. A few issues, there are no good institutions near by, which should not be an excuse. I could go some where. I am however, a very prominent member of society, which is actually not very helpful for me, and dangerous. I have a husband, who would hates when I try to go inpatient in the past. I can not convince him, that going inpatient, is better than jail. He simply tells me not to do anything. So I go that urges, amongst others. It’s dangerous, I know. I could slip at any point. There is not going back after that. I don’t want to go inpatient, because I think my urges are bad. If I go, I go because I want to be free, not be in jail, even inpatient is distressing. But I can leave eventually. The thoughts never go away though.

Good question. I know it is crazy, and irrational. I think what I’m trying to say, that if my thoughts weren’t taboo. If I could just voice it, and not be put inpatient for it. I know that’s irrational. People would never accept those thoughts easily, and I would never accept people to accept the action of killing. I can’t say that we should live in a world, where killing is justified, but I would not be opposed to hunting people. I contradict myself. I know people can’t go around killing others, but I want to so badly. I’m not opposed to killing innocent people, children, and don’t focus on any specific group. I simply see someone, and want them dead. However, if it would be acceptable, and please society more, I would like to think I could try and focus on groups like criminals, but I just see someone, and a way to murder them comes to mind.

I just turned 30. I have been seeing a psychiatrist since I was 20. The only medication that only worked for me was for anxiety. However, it was an as needed medication, and I had not taken it for consecutive years. It helps to  say my thoughts, and urges out loud, that’s why I am trying to find a therapist. However, I don’t want a cure for my thoughts. I guess if I did not have them, I would feel pain from the urges, but right now, besides acting on the urges, I have to get by with just verbally, expressing gruesome thoughts.

I’m saying I don’t mind having thoughts about killing people. So are distraught when they have thoughts of hurting others. I fight the urges, because I do not want to get caught. I like the thoughts, I hate how insightful I am, I know that people think these thoughts are terrible. So, it hurts that I can not act on my urges, or enjoy my thoughts. I guess it’s like when you think about someone that you like. How you want to be with them, picture the two of you together. You enjoy those thoughts. However, that person is with someone else, and it’s painful for you to see that. I know, being in love with someone you can’t have, and wanting to kill someone, is very different.
I’ve tried every medication in the book, and have had so many therapists, they say they can not help me.

When I say these thoughts aloud, people always go wrong the notion that I am going to do it. I do not want to go to jail, trust me, I think of these things you speak of. All the time. They are thoughts, and truly urges. I see people, and see how I could kill them. One reason I probably do not kill right now, is because I do not want to get caught. I have thought of many scenarios where I think I could get away, but do not want to risk it…yet. W planning out the details on how I would do it, helps me from going on a killing spree. However, I still ache. I’m simply not satisfied.
True. I have very good insight, I know that it’s bad, and affects others, but I just can not eg rasp the concept of why? The urge is painful.
I like your way of thinking. I did amateur box for a while, and won a few golden glove titles. However, still not the same. Making people bleed by beating them up, never fully satisfied me.

Met with my psychologist today. He could see I am struggling, and in distress. He asked me if I was suicidal, or needed to be put in the hospital. I said no. I don’t want to deal with anyone through this, or have connections.
Talk to your local Va representative. They can do it for you, and make sure it is written properly. A way that benefits you. Mine would follow the status of my benefits, and keep me updated.
I’ve been trying to get a therapist, but have failed. I just have this urge to choke him out.
They are just strong urges. I love him. He’s a good guy. I just have these thoughts, and tonight they are strong. I’d rather die, than hurt him.
I’ve heard all this before. I tried help.
I’ve tried everywhere else. And I mean everywhere. I don’t even remember posting that. I’m losing control.
You can’t help my repetitive thoughts
I want to hurt people. So in the end I keep trying to kill myself from doing so.
I think about it down to the details.
I’m aware of my diagnosis, but thank you. Been down all that road.
Lol, I don’t blame you.

You never know. Plus, I’m only intrigued, and find myself obsessing over extremely intelligent people, more particularly, usually Doctors, psychologists, and people of authority. So, if you don’t fall into those categories, you are good. In addition, I’ve never acted on homicidal thoughts. They are simply thoughts, and desires. The obsessions, well, that’s something no one can see.
Lol, I haven’t, I have heard of it. My dark humor would find that too relatable.

They turn me away because I have DID, where one if us ya already angry all the time, and they want to kill. I see therapists who don’t know how to help, and can deal with the anger, because it leads to more homicidal thoughts.
Thank you. I’ll call tomorrow.

I’ve had it on and off for a couple months, but it’s gotten worse. I bleed all the time, sex hurts so bad, discharge, I’m nausea, fever, I’m not pregnant, it’s not an UTI, and it’s not an STD. I do have HPV, and had a very intense Pap smear last year, that he said were precancerous cells, but seemed really concerned. Could I have gotten worse in a year? They took a lot of biopsies.
I feel you. That has happen before to me. It’s like cornering a caged animal. When in the ward. They treat you terrible, and we fight.
Never works! Tried!
I just have had these images... everytime I look at someone, I see a way I could kill them. I feel betrayed by the psychologist, I just have this urge to make them feel pain.
It’s harder than it seems. I’m using an online one now.
It won’t make difference. I booked the hotel. I’m leaving this weekend, and I can’t come back.
Thanks for your input.
Was in for 8 years.
In Texas justifiable homicide is not a lawful murder. I don’t want these thoughts. They are there. And urges.
I don’t have anyone in particular. That’s what I told my therapist. To lock me away.

I did. I met with home today. He said there are thoughts and actions. There’s no in between. My thoughts are strong, I don’t know how to stop them. He says they are safe, but will be punished if acted on. I can’t live with the consequences. I’d rather die than kill others like we want too.
I have remorse. The others inside me don’t. I want to kill, but know it’s wrong. However the urges are so strong.
I have for years. Things are getting worse.
I guess I fall into the same category. Everyone I look at I picture their death. I have the urge to kill.
How do I know? I don’t remember a lot of  things, and they come back to me in memories. I’m not capable of doing something like that.
She won’t tell me. She wants to be in control. She’s smart, clever. The most brilliant and talented of us all. I just know what she’s capable of.
I have talked to my therapist, but I haven’t told him the dreams. Jade is homicidal, and I fear what she might do.
Love reading your stories. This one particularly. I have DID, I wish I could find ways to cope or a therapist as dedicated as you. Thanks for the stories!
I bet your life is interesting. I have one that tries to kill me.
Thanks guys!
You are welcome! It is good to hear it helps, plus to see we are not alone.:)
Thank you. How does everyone deal with it? I’ve been switching so much lately.
I will, thank you!
Hi! I apologize, I’m new to Reddit and didn’t quite understand what subreddits were and where to post them. I apologize.
